title: Meeting Rooms II (Sweep Line)
statement: Given an array of meeting time intervals `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [starti, endi]`, return the minimum number of conference rooms required.
inputFormat:
Line 1: N (number of meetings).
Next N lines: two space-separated integers (start and end).

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
intervals = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
